username.label: Anthbot account username
username.help: The email address associated with your Anthbot account

areaCode.label: Area code
areaCode.help: Examples: 49 for Germany, 32 for Belgium, 1 for US/Canada

errorDescriptionLanguage.label: Error description language
errorDescriptionLanguage.help: Language used for Anthbot cloud error descriptions

pollIntervalActive.label: Poll interval while active (seconds)
pollIntervalActive.help: Refresh interval while mowing, mapping, returning or remote controlling

pollIntervalCharging.label: Poll interval while charging (seconds)
pollIntervalCharging.help: Refresh interval while the mower is charging

pollIntervalIdle.label: Poll interval during recent idle (seconds)
pollIntervalIdle.help: Refresh interval during the first minutes in standby or pause

pollIntervalIdleLong.label: Poll interval during long idle (seconds)
pollIntervalIdleLong.help: Reduced refresh interval after the mower has remained idle for longer

idleLongAfterMinutes.label: Long idle starts after (minutes)
idleLongAfterMinutes.help: After this time in standby or pause, the long-idle interval is used

nightPollingEnabled.label: Enable reduced polling at night
nightPollingEnabled.help: Use a separate interval during the configured night window while Kevin is not active

pollIntervalNight.label: Poll interval at night (seconds)
pollIntervalNight.help: Refresh interval in the optional night window

nightStartHour.label: Night starts at (hour)
nightStartHour.help: Local server hour from which night polling is used

nightEndHour.label: Night ends at (hour)
nightEndHour.help: Local server hour at which normal polling resumes
